posts.body:
Heyo ;D
DevonRexxx
here, your favorite theoretical game developer you've never heard of before!
Half making this as a way to be able to set a profile picture. (The other half is to get out of mods approving everything I post.)
MV fanboy here
(MZ caused the alien invasions)
with +250 hours without a single game released!!!
I'm making the best game ever right now tho so it's fine.
My games are all gonna about cats, felines, and felis catus :3
Been interested in RPG Maker since binge watching MBH's horror RM game videos.
Interested in game development since I fell down five flights of stairs as a toddler.
By the way, have I mentioned me liking video games? Who would've guessed?
Main inspirations for stuff I do are Devil May Cry and Guilty Gear.
Do some art sometimes. Here's some stuff I've made.
Spoiler:
Art
Favorite color? Purple.
Best ice-cream flavor? Mint Chocolate Chip. (Don't let anyone tell you it tastes like toothpaste. That just means they've never brushed their teeth before.)
Happy to be here with y'all,
